newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns cuts AT&T 1997 estimate.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns cuts AT&T 1997 estimate.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Bette Massick cut AT&T 1997 estimate to $3.20 from $3.65, citing uncollectible revenues from delinquent and bad debts from business customers and resellers. -- "You have to cut your number for that alone," she said. -- Also expects extra $750 million spending on PCS and local market entry this year vs last. -- Assumes core long distance business will improve during year.
-- Bear Stearns remains neutral on stock.
